rationale: BUG-2788: two autouse conftest fixtures forced a fresh tmp_path per test (~13.7k roots/run), driving macOS launchservicesd/fseventsd to ~220% CPU and causing full-suite beachballs. Session-scoped shared paths with per-request reuse fixed it.
rule: Avoid autouse pytest fixtures that unconditionally request tmp_path or perform filesystem writes (mkdir, file creation)
